title: Read and select the shared command instruments
description: Actual production CommandControl in gallery and lab. Local selection callbacks are not server receipts. Command selection is immediate, with unchanged results under normal/reduced preference; no animation is fast-forwarded.

steps.description: Select history with the keyboard under normal system preference; inspect the rounded painted face and complete semantic target.
steps.acknowledgement: The actual shared callback updates one current command and the named local status.
verifications: Rounded artwork is noninteractive, all corner probes hit the semantic button, and actual motion preference is honored without changing selection semantics.
Normal-motion device preference; finite effects settled without fast-forward and exact pixels unchanged.
